title: Etale cohomology of sheaves
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and let $F\in\Ab(T_{\Et})$ be an etale abelian sheaf
[def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of $T$. The *(etale) cohomology groups* of $F$
are

$$
 H^q(T_{\Et},F)=\mathcal H^q\bigl(\Gamma(T,I^\bullet)\bigr)
 \qquad(q\geq0),
$$

where $F\to I^\bullet$ is a K-injective resolution
[def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions] of $F$ (as a complex in degree $0$), which exists and is
unique up to chain-homotopy equivalence [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist], and
$\Gamma(T,-)=\Gamma(T_{\Et},-)$ is the functor of global sections
[def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor], applied termwise. For
$K\in\Dplus(T_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], let $K\to\operatorname{Kinj}(K)$ be a
K-injective resolution of a complex representing $K$
[prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist], and write

$$
 \RGamma(T_{\Et},K)=\Gamma(T,\operatorname{Kinj}(K)),\qquad
 H^q(T_{\Et},K)=\mathcal H^q\bigl(\RGamma(T_{\Et},K)\bigr)
$$

for the derived global sections and the derived cohomology groups.
